definition_en: Strength Half-Life is the time for a team's estimated strength to lose half its excess over the league mean, measured by the exponential decay rate of its rating, not by a fixed calendar window.

fields.E0: excess strength over league mean at last observation
fields.H: half-life in days, estimated per league from the rating series itself
fields.h_governs: stored excess strength (data), not the update step / learning rate
fields.stale_rule: a rating older than 2H is marked stale and must not be used silently
fields.t: age of the rating in days since the team's last observed match
fields.window: declared per league; a rating must report t, H, window and league
